	<ResortReportHeadline>Sunday Stunner!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>It looks like a cracker of a day on the way!&nbsp; The sky is clear, and there is just a puff of a breeze from the west.&nbsp; The current temp is a balmy 4.6 degrees, heading for a top of 6 degrees, but thanks to the humidity plummeting in the early hours, the snowguns fired up and are still pumping it out as I write.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>The snow has set up overnight and will start the day off very firm before the sunny aspects soften as the day warms.&nbsp; South facing slopes may stay slick all day.&nbsp; The groomed runs will certainly be the best option this morning.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>Due to the shallow cover, the Village Loop and Heavenly Valley have been upgraded to advanced skiers and riders only, and there may be a delayed opening of Heavenly Valley if it's too slick.&nbsp;</p><p>Slap on the screen and follow the sun for fun turns all day.&nbsp;</p><p>Cheers BIll</p><p><br></p></ResortReport>
